a1.label: A1 · Beginner
a1.cefrGuide: Use only the ~600 most common English words. Present simple, short sentences of 4-8 words, no phrasal verbs, no idioms, no relative clauses. Everyday concrete topics.

a2.label: A2 · Elementary
a2.cefrGuide: Use the ~1500 most common words. Past simple, future with going to, comparatives, common phrasal verbs (get up, look for). Sentences of 6-12 words. Familiar everyday topics.

b1.label: B1 · Intermediate
b1.cefrGuide: Use the ~2500 most common words. Present perfect, conditionals 1 and 2, passive voice, common collocations and phrasal verbs. Sentences of 10-18 words. Work, travel, opinions, experiences.

b2.label: B2 · Upper-Intermediate
b2.cefrGuide: Use ~4000-word range including abstract vocabulary. Mixed conditionals, perfect modals, cleft sentences, nuanced connectors (nonetheless, whereas). Idioms and collocations welcome. Abstract and professional topics, argumentation.

c1.label: C1 · Advanced
c1.cefrGuide: Use precise, low-frequency and academic vocabulary, register shifts, hedging, inversion, nominalisation, subtle idiom and connotation. Long complex sentences. Academic, cultural, scientific and rhetorical topics.
